skill.name: conversion-value-mapper
skill.description: Use when you need to define or QA conversion values for paid ad bidding. It maps purchase revenue, margin, COGS, and proxy values into a launch-ready value model for tROAS or max-conversion-value campaigns; use related skills for tag plumbing, attribution de-duplication, and final account scoring.
skill.summary: Builds margin-aware conversion value models for paid ad bidding.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Value-based bidding fails when platforms optimize toward gross revenue, missing margins, or guessed lead values. This skill turns revenue, margin, COGS, and proxy assumptions into a clear value model and QA checklist.
actual_capabilities: Defines conversion value models for tROAS and max-conversion-value bidding.
Maps purchase revenue to margin-adjusted or COGS-adjusted net value.
Derives proxy values for leads, calls, and signups from downstream economics.
Chooses static, dynamic, or segment-based value rules with rationale.
Runs a value-versus-count sanity check before launch.
Produces a value-model spec, QA sheet, and handoff for account auditing.
limitations: It does not verify tag firing, UTM quality, or event plumbing.
It does not perform cross-platform attribution de-duplication or incrementality analysis.
It needs user-provided revenue, margin, COGS, close-rate, or AOV inputs for measured outputs.
It provides a planning workflow, not direct changes inside ad platforms.

use_cases.title: Profit-based ecommerce bidding
use_cases.description: Map SKU or category margins onto purchase values before switching campaigns to tROAS.

use_cases.title: Lead value calibration
use_cases.description: Create defensible proxy values for leads, phone calls, and signups using close rate and net order value.

use_cases.title: Pre-launch value QA
use_cases.description: Check whether platform conversion value tracks business profit before increasing spend.

prompt_templates.title: Start a value model
prompt_templates.prompt: Map my paid ad conversion values for tROAS. My bid goal is [goal], my conversion actions are [actions], and my revenue source is [GA4 or ecommerce export].

prompt_templates.title: Adjust purchase value for margin
prompt_templates.scenario: Ecommerce account with margin or COGS data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a margin-adjusted value model from my purchase revenue export and my margin or COGS breakdown by [SKU, category, or blended rate]. Identify any rows that need more input.

prompt_templates.title: Derive proxy values
prompt_templates.prompt: Create proxy values for [lead, call, signup] using average order net value, close rate, and any available funnel data. Mark measured, user-provided, estimated, and needs-input values.

prompt_templates.title: Run full value QA
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my full conversion value model before launch. Check dynamic versus static values, value rules, margin adjustment, proxy derivations, value-versus-count reconciliation, launch readiness, and the next skill handoff.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce account has purchase revenue by category and margins ranging from 20 percent to 70 percent.
output: A value basis table that labels purchase revenue as measured and margin as user-provided.
A net value formula for each category using revenue multiplied by margin or revenue minus COGS.
A launch-readiness note that flags any missing category margin before tROAS activation.

output_examples.input: A lead generation account tracks form fills and phone calls but has no transaction value in the ad platform.
output: Proxy value calculations based on average order net value and lead-to-sale close rate.
Needs-input flags where close rate or average order value is missing.
A recommendation on whether max-conversion-value bidding has enough value data to launch.

output_examples.input: A platform reports high conversion value, but finance reports much lower net contribution.
output: A value-versus-count reconciliation that compares platform value with booked net profit.
A list of likely causes such as gross revenue bidding, duplicated adjustments, or missing COGS.
A handoff to the paid account auditor when the value model is ready for scoring.

best_practices: Label every value as measured, user-provided, estimated, or needs-input.
Use margin-adjusted net value when profit differs meaningfully from gross revenue.
Run value-versus-count reconciliation before increasing spend under value-based bidding.
anti_patterns: Do not invent round-number lead values without close-rate or order-value support.
Do not apply value rules that double-adjust values already converted to net profit.
Do not treat this workflow as proof that conversion tags fire correctly.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build a conversion value model for paid ad bidding, including revenue values, margin adjustments, proxy values, and QA checks.

faq.question: Can it work with manual exports?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to work from user-provided GA4, ecommerce, margin, COGS, close-rate, or AOV exports.

faq.question: Does it check whether my conversion tag fires?
faq.answer: No. Use a conversion signal QA workflow for tag firing, UTMs, and event plumbing before relying on the value model.

faq.question: Does it solve attribution duplication?
faq.answer: No. It defines the value sent to a platform. Cross-platform order de-duplication and incrementality require a separate attribution workflow.

faq.question: How are non-revenue actions valued?
faq.answer: The skill derives proxy values from expected downstream net value, usually average order net value multiplied by lead-to-sale close rate.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before launching or scaling tROAS, max-conversion-value, or other value-based paid ad bidding strategies.
